sources.page: List of presidents of the United States

us-presidents.note: Only the presidents who took office before 2000 (Washington to Clinton); Grover Cleveland is one answer.

sources.page: List of Nobel Peace Prize laureates

nobel-peace.note: Prizes from 1901 to 2000; a laureate who won more than once (the Red Cross, the UNHCR) is one answer; the years with no prize are left out.

sources.page: List of prime ministers of the United Kingdom

uk-prime-ministers.note: Only those who first took office from 1901 to 2000 (Balfour to Blair).

sources.page: List of heads of state and government who were assassinated or executed
List of heads of state and government who were sentenced to death

assassinated-leaders.note: From the second list, only those executed: rows whose notes say the sentence was commuted, passed in absentia or never carried out are left out. Atahualpa is added by hand.

english-monarchs.note: From William the Conqueror on; Lady Jane Grey, Empress Matilda, Henry the Young King and Louis VIII of France are accepted as disputed monarchs.

japanese-periods.note: The periods of Japanese history, with the modern eras (Meiji to Reiwa) as periods; the short era names (nengō) such as Genroku are not periods.

List of countries that have gained independence from the United Kingdom
List of countries that have gained independence from the United Kingdom

uk-independence.note: Tables 1 and 2 (the dominions) whole, and Rhodesia from table 4; Singapore, which left through Malaysia, is added by hand.

former-communist-states.note: Every state that no longer exists as a communist state; China, Cuba, Laos, North Korea and Vietnam are left out while they remain communist.
